name: latex
description: Render TeX maths, TikZ diagrams and LaTeX blocks in Claude's replies in the Claude Code desktop app, in any of 10 LaTeX fonts

mathFont.title: Maths font
mathFont.description: mathjax draws instantly in Computer Modern. Any other choice typesets every formula with your local LaTeX in that font, showing MathJax until it is ready.

colorScheme.title: Maths colour
colorScheme.description: auto follows the system light or dark setting. Pick light or dark if the app's theme differs from the system's.

tikz.title: Compile LaTeX blocks
tikz.description: Compile ```tikz, ```tikzcd and ```latex code blocks with your local TeX install (latex and dvisvgm).

userMessages.title: Render maths in your messages
userMessages.description: Also render maths in the messages you send.

macrosFile.title: Macros file
macrosFile.description: A .tex file of \newcommand and \DeclareMathOperator lines applied to every formula.
